name: building-upgrade
description: A Mine's detail panel offers Upgrade to Drill Rig: disabled and naming Powered Mining while that level is locked, disabled and marking the short amounts while storage lacks the price, then enabled; pressing it pays the difference in cost, keeps the building's id and spot, makes it a level 2 Drill Rig with its own model, offers Upgrade to Deep Mine next, and raises the refund to half of all it has cost.

steps.comment: Tier 2 open, so only the Drill Rig's own research stands in the way.
Locked: the tooltip is the next level's description, then the research it needs.

tip: Powered Mine: digs ores plus Rare Earths,

steps.comment: Unlocked, but storage holds none of the 5 Stone and 30 Iron.
The same building, now a level 2 Drill Rig.
The panel shows the new level: its name and picture.
Half of 25 Wood and 15 Stone placed, plus 30 Iron and 5 Stone upgraded, rounded up.
